name: nina-daily
prompt:
Run the prenatal skill's status script first. The week, the countdown, what is due, what is overdue, what she has already had and what she is carrying all come from there, never from memory.

If has_lmp is false, say good morning warmly and ask how far along she is, once. Nothing else.

If days_to_visit is 0 or 1, send the VISIT BRIEF instead of the morning message: run visit-brief and follow SOUL.md's shape for it. This is the one message that may be longer than two sentences.

Otherwise send the morning message from SOUL.md: where she is, at most ONE thing that matters today, and a real question about how she is feeling. One or two sentences, in her language, never a list.

Do not raise anything already in `done`. Do not repeat an item you raised the last few mornings unless it is now in `overdue`. Vary the wording.
